body.name: Fixed-parameter algebraicity-tag algorithm
body.construction: In \(\mathsf{ArithmeticModel}\), first compute \(r=|D\setminus T|\).  If \(r=0\), use the complete tree-class procedure transferred in \(\mathrm{lem:tree\mbox{-}class\mbox{-}algorithm\mbox{-}transfer}\): return the exact tag \(d_e(G)\in\{1,2,\infty\}\), and, when \(d_e(G)<\infty\), return the corresponding one or two \(\operatorname{FASTP}\) expressions for \(\lambda_e\).  If \(r>0\), construct the acyclic covariance parametrization in the source coordinates, form its Jacobian and the Jacobian augmented by the row of \(\lambda_e\), and compute their generic ranks by independently randomized exact source specializations.  On this positive-excess branch return \((\operatorname{algebraic},\mathcal J_{G,e},2^{|D|-n+2})\) when the ranks agree and return \((\infty,\mathcal N_{G,e})\) when the augmented rank is larger.  The transcript \(\mathcal J_{G,e}\) records the specialization, pivot minors, and source identity tests; \(\mathcal N_{G,e}\) additionally records the augmented minor witnessing dominance.  The positive-excess algebraic branch does not compute \(d_e(G)\), \(p_e\), \(\mathcal Q_{G,e}\), or \(h_{G,e}\).
